newsitem.title: USA: Biogen says Avonex gets positive response.
newsitem.headline: Biogen says Avonex gets positive response.

text.p: Biogen Inc said Thursday that its drug for treating relapsing multiple sclerosis has received a positive response from a panel of the European Medicines Evaluation Agency.
The interferon beta-la drug, which will be marketed under the brand name Avonex, received a positive opinion from the Committee for Proprietary Medicinal Products.

The drug is now before the European Commission for final review and approval, the company said. Final commission action grants marketing authorization that is effective in 15 members states of the European Union.
Avonex was licensed in May 1996 for the U.S. market. The company also has applied for market approval in Australia, Canada, New Zealand, Switzerland and Norway.
